{"notes": "VISIT 4 (left 6:45). Table: the whole fish is now dark and connected. That covers the body, the lower fork out to ~(28,13.2) and the upper lobe, including the tip near (27-29, 7-8) that was pale last visit. The gap has been closed, but I didn't see who closed it and still can't credit anyone for the build. Belly double line near (13-16, 14) is dense but connected. Open: whether it falls as one piece, which only the push will show.

TOM: At 6:15 he located the break at the bend, one domino off the line, with four pale ones beyond it. That matches the pale tip I saw earlier, and the tip is now connected. He asked Leo whether to fix it or leave it to him, so he checked in rather than overriding. This is the first time I've seen him find the gap. Collaboration is strong (4 observations) and leadership is plausible. I still don't know whether he placed the fix himself.

PRIYA: At 6:30 she said the whole run falls from the start, including the lower fork, and asked people not to touch it before the push. The table supports this, since everything is dark. It was an accurate, useful call that protects the build. Clear communicator, consistently reliable. Leadership is positive.

MAYA: I saw nothing from her this visit. Earlier notes still stand: she misheard Priya's handover and called the lobe 'done' while the tip was pale, though she did go to check joins. Ask her privately what she placed.

LEO: Nothing new this visit. He was asked at 6:15 whether he had the break and I didn't see a reply. His earlier flag of the break was real, but his claim to have fixed anything is unverified. Ask him privately.

NEXT: Watch the push. Ask Leo and Maya privately what they placed."}
